arxiv-2410-20035.title: Training the Untrainable: Introducing Inductive Bias via Representational Alignment
arxiv-2410-20035.creator: Vighnesh Subramaniam, David Mayo, Colin Conwell, Tomaso Poggio, Boris Katz, Brian Cheung , Andrei Barbu
arxiv-2410-20035.description: Abstract We demonstrate that architectures which traditionally are considered to be ill-suited for a task can be trained using inductive biases from another architecture. We call a network untrainable when it overfits, underfits, or converges to poor results even when tuning their hyperparameters. For example, fully connected networks overfit on object recognition while deep convolutional networks without residual connections underfit.

arxiv-2507-11063.title: A Distance Metric for Mixed Integer Programming Instances
arxiv-2507-11063.creator: Gwen Maudet, Grégoire Danoy
arxiv-2507-11063.description: Abstract Mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) is a powerful tool for addressing a wide range of real-world problems, but it lacks a clear structure for comparing instances. A reliable similarity metric could establish meaningful relationships between instances, enabling more effective evaluation of instance set heterogeneity and providing better guidance to solvers, particularly when machine learning is involved.

arxiv-2510-26289.title: Contribution-Guided Asymmetric Learning for Robust Multimodal Fusion under Imbalance and Noise Thanks: These authors contributed equally to this work. Corresponding Author: Hong Liu, yunkou1232@gmail.com.
arxiv-2510-26289.creator: Zijing Xu, Yunfeng Kou, Kunming Wu, Hong Liu
arxiv-2510-26289.description: Abstract Multimodal learning faces two major challenges: modality imbalance and data noise, which significantly affect the robustness and generalization ability of models. Existing methods achieve modality balance by suppressing dominant modalities, but they neglect the inherent differences in the information value between modalities, potentially leading to convergence to suboptimal solutions.

arxiv-2511-12926.title: Stability of Non-Hyperbolic Sets
arxiv-2511-12926.creator: Marco Martens, Liviana Palmisano
arxiv-2511-12926.description: Abstract In families of unfoldings we find codimension-one laminations consisting of maps exibiting an invariant, non-hyperbolic Cantor set containing a Collet–Eckmann point whose orbit is dense in the set. The topology of this Cantor set remains unchanged along the leaves of the lamination, ensuring codimension-one stability.

pmc-10518973.creator: Sophie Witter, Guanyang Zou, Kiran Cheedella, John Walley, Haja Wurie
pmc-10518973.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundWhen the COVID pandemic hit the world, there was need for applied guides and training materials to support frontline health care staff to manage patients effectively and safely and to educate themselves and communities. This article reports on the development and piloting of such a set of materials in Sierra Leone, which were based on international evidence but adapted to the local context.

Spherical equivalent refraction (SER) degree was calculated.

pmc-11569169.creator: Yushuai Zhang, Wangjun Ren, Yicun Chen, Yongtao Mi, Jiyong Lei, Licheng Sun
pmc-11569169.description: Reliable predictions of concrete strength can reduce construction time and labor costs, providing strong support for building construction quality inspection. To enhance the accuracy of concrete strength prediction, this paper introduces an interpretable framework for machine learning (ML) models to predict the compressive strength of high-performance concrete (HPC).

pmc-11614861.title: Electrochemical lithium extraction from hectorite ore
pmc-11614861.creator: Andrew Z Haddad, Hyungyeon Cha, Liam McDonough, Chaochao Dun, Garrett Pohlman, Jeffrey J Urban, Robert Kostecki
pmc-11614861.description: Electrochemical technologies add a unique dimension for ore refinement, representing tunable methods that can integrate with renewable energy sources and existing downstream process flows. However, the development of electrochemical extraction technologies has been impeded by the technological maturity of hydro- and pyro-metallurgy, as well as the electrical insulating properties of many metal oxide ores.

Trehalose involved in plant responses to multiple adverse environmental stresses, including heat stress. pmc-11656900.description: BackgroundTranscription factors (TFs) bind regulatory genomic regions to orchestrate spatio-temporal expression of target genes. Global dissection of the cistrome is critical for elucidating transcriptional networks underlying complex agronomic traits in crops.ResultsHere, we generate a comprehensive genome-wide binding map for 148 TFs using DNA affinity purification sequencing in soybean.

pmc-12655780.title: Exploring Intrapersonal and Extrapersonal Factors Influencing Iranian Women’s Indescribable Pleasure: A Content Analysis Study
pmc-12655780.creator: Leila Bozorgian, Abbas Ebadi, Fatemeh Janipour, Simin Montazeri
pmc-12655780.description: Background:Natural childbirth is one of the most challenging psychological events in women’s lives. Women’s perceptions of this experience exert a profound influence on their psychological state and can impact maternal and infant health outcomes. Therefore, this study aimed to explain Iranian women’s experience with pleasant natural childbirth.Materials and Methods:This qualitative study employed conventional content analysis.

pmc-12985155.title: Processability of Ancient Wheats for Novel Value Chains and Agro-Food Biodiversity
pmc-12985155.creator: Francesca Nocente, Diana DeSantis, Marta Naso, Gaia Blandizzi, Margherita Modesti, Serena Ferri, Gabriele Chilosi, Laura Gazza
pmc-12985155.description: Modern wheat breeding has focused on maximizing yields under high-input systems. Although ancient wheat varieties generally show lower yields and no clear nutritional superiority, they are increasingly valued in organic and local food systems for their resilience, cultural identity, and suitability for artisanal processing.

pmc-13026345.title: Postoperative Buttock Skin Injuries Not Explained by Electrosurgical Burns: Three Cases Suggesting an Ischemia–Reperfusion Mechanism
pmc-13026345.creator: Hiroshi Tanabe, Yoshinori Nakamura
pmc-13026345.description: Postoperative buttock skin lesions are uncommon complications that can cause severe pain and delayed healing. While often attributed to pressure, some clinical reports have classified them as electrosurgical burns. However, the electrophysical plausibility of this attribution under standard operating conditions is uncertain.

pmc-13251886.title: The CONTEXT trial: Real world clinical use of GIQuant—a motility MRI based activity biomarker for small bowel Crohn’s disease
pmc-13251886.creator: Alex Menys, Iyad Naim, Joy Barber, Kamal Patel, Nirav Patel, Attah Ocholi, Samantha Baillie, Nkem Onyeador, Victoria Jennings, Sudheer Vuyyuru, Christopher Clarke, Rahul Munyal, Gauraang Bhatnagar, Thomas Shepherd, Laurence Bourn, Sara Upponi, Juan De la Revilla Negro, Anish Kuzhiyanjal, Jimmi Limdi
pmc-13251886.description: BackgroundMotility MRI is a validated marker of small bowel Crohn’s disease (CD) activity. Objective assessment of small bowel motility with GIQuant (Motilent, London, U.K.) may have a valuable role to play in personalised patient care. The aim of this study was to assess the impact of implementing GIQuant on clinical impressions around treatment response in small bowel CD.

pmc-13454667.title: Subsequent Thromboembolic and Bleeding Events in Patients With Major Bleeding While on Factor Xa Inhibitors
pmc-13454667.creator: Takahiro Suzuki, Masahiro Yasaka, Fumitaka Wada, Ryotaro Ide, Kota Suzuki, Shun Kohsaka
pmc-13454667.description: BackgroundManagement of patients after bleeding associated with Factor Xa inhibitors (FXa-I) remains challenging due to limited available data on unpredictable sequencing of bleeding and thromboembolic events.Methods and ResultsThis cohort study identified 5,349 patients with FXa-I-related major bleeding. During the 360-day follow-up, bleeding events were highest in the first 90 days (42.2 per 100 person-years), declining to 18.6 by days 271–360.

pmc-13639039.title: Deep learning based histomorphological phenotyping and prognostic stratification for combined SCLC and LCNEC
pmc-13639039.creator: Lin Yang, Ruyu Sheng, Zijian Yang, Yibo Zhang, Taolue Wang, Fan Yang, Shilong Liu, Meng Zhou
pmc-13639039.description: Prognostic stratification for combined small and large cell neuroendocrine lung carcinoma (cSCLC-LCNEC) remains challenging. We introduce GTBIS, an interpretable deep learning model for histomorphological phenotyping and prognostic stratification of cSCLC-LCNEC from pathology images. In multicenter cohorts (n = 670), GTBIS accurately differentiated SCLC from LCNEC.

uslaw-usc-t12-s1761d.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s1761d.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 14 (Federal Credit Unions); Subchapter I (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The supervisory committee shall make or cause to be made an annual audit and shall submit a report of that audit to the board of directors and a summary of the report to the members at the next annual meeting.
